# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Native hardening and Uno compatibility**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 brings native security backports and restores Uno WebAssembly linking on newer .NET targets. The servicing update keeps the Skia m155 engine line and managed API unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Security

- **Skia security backports** — Backports 25 CVE fixes and 13 additional hardening and test fixes to Skia m155, covering shader execution, GPU resource lifetimes, texture sampling, glyph bounds and allocation arithmetic. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno WebAssembly linking** — Fixes the conflicting WebGPU linker flags that prevented Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer from linking on .NET 9 and later. The .NET 8 WebGPU flag is retained. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
